name: Bowmark
description: Hosted Bowmark MCP server: gives AI agents typed functions for real websites (LinkedIn, YouTube, Amazon, Reddit, Airbnb, flights and more) through one MCP server. The agent discovers functions with get_library and calls them with run; results come back as typed data, and every function is tested on a schedule. Sign in with OAuth; start with a free $10. Also installable locally as a stdio bridge (npx bowmark-mcp, uvx bowmark-mcp).
author: Bowmark AI
